scope: UX refinement after T105: child views replace parent views and return to their parent when editing or inspection ends.

source.explorerCommitMessage: fix(query): Запросы заменяют вкладки родителя до закрытия

artifacts.bundleHashMethod: SHA-256 of the compact sorted JSON mapping artifact names to their SHA-256 digests

architecture: ESKA remains responsible for source extraction, owner snapshots, permissions, checkpoints, conflict detection, constructor operations and verified write plans.
The IDE adapter alone owns tab identity, selection, focus redirection, readonly comparison mirrors and native Undo/Redo application. No VS Code identity or new domain edit model was added to ESKA.
Opening a query hides file, protected and split views of its parent. Native dirty-close decisions are explicit Save, Do not save or Cancel; the ESKA session captures the result after that decision.
Parent navigation returns to the deepest active child. Constructor and owner comparison replace the query until they close. Both comparison sides reject writes.
Apply, Cancel, Keep and an unchanged close return the parent. XML Save ends XML query editing; BSL Save remains checkpoint-only. Cancelled closure keeps the child active.
Native readonly overrides are preserved. External or programmatic source edits remain possible and are rejected by the unchanged core conflict checks.

rustGates.reason: No Rust source, dependencies or build configuration changed; the ESKA repository contains documentation and this report only.

nativeCoverage: One query replaces file/protected/split parent views; reopening the parent does not permit interactive typing.
Constructor closure returns the same draft; reopening the query while the constructor is active returns focus to the constructor.
Readonly comparison replaces the query; an external native edit updates the current side, preserves the original side and causes a core Apply conflict.
Apply returns one unsaved parent, leaves the disk unchanged and is one native Undo operation.
Explicit Cancel, unchanged close, Keep, Discard and cancelled closure return the expected parent or child.
SCD and dynamic list Save return XML and preserve the other query.
Normal installed windows exercise actual native Save, Do not save and Cancel dialogs in both locales, and preserve the prior native readonly override.
A separate buhmfo copy with five extensions exercises installed public commands, actual constructor DOM actions, published analyzer metadata completion and one-Undo unsaved application.
Two normal installed processes per locale restore the query without auto-application, retain modal navigation and require explicit Resume before Apply.

correctedValidationAttempts.issue: A parent-open event could finish after the first focus guard.
correctedValidationAttempts.resolution: Re-evaluate parent views after successful guarding; native parent navigation passed in both locales.

correctedValidationAttempts.issue: An external WorkspaceEdit could reveal a dirty parent in another group; returning to the original group created two parent tabs.
correctedValidationAttempts.resolution: Restore the original view and close only duplicate text views while retaining the same dirty native model; both locale suites passed.

correctedValidationAttempts.issue: Extension-test windows bypass native dirty save confirmations.
correctedValidationAttempts.resolution: Validate all native save decisions in normal installed windows using a disposable startup probe.

correctedValidationAttempts.issue: The first buhmfo workspace did not pin the supplied backend and selected an incompatible global backend.
correctedValidationAttempts.resolution: The host runner now writes the supplied executable into the performance workspace settings; both normal buhmfo runs passed.

correctedValidationAttempts.issue: The first final Node suite ran concurrently with compilation regenerating icon resources and observed a partial directory.
correctedValidationAttempts.resolution: Rerun after compilation settled; all 270 eligible tests passed, with three expected skips.

limitations: Windows, macOS, VS Code, Remote and other IDE adapters were not tested.
This is modal IDE navigation, not an operating-system file lock; external or programmatic edits still require core conflict detection.
Only the native suites listed in this report were run for the UX refinement; historical acceptance files retain their original contracts and measurements.
The full T105 performance series, platform build/round-trip and query execution in an infobase were not rerun for this adapter-only change.
The existing manual test window was left running. Its next run.sh launch installs the updated VSIX; no live profile or copied source file was changed.
